top_signals.title: Longsys Founder Bets Big on R&D to Ride AI Memory Wave
top_signals.summary: Longsys Electronics Founder Cai Huabo says 78% of proceeds will go into research and development as the company shifts from a module house to a semiconductor memory brand. With expansion plans in Brazil, Europe, and the US, Longsys aims to break the industry’s price‑driven cycle and position itself at the forefront of AI‑era innovation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan 5-Year Bond Sale Sees Weaker Demand Than 12-Month Average
top_signals.summary: Japan’s five-year government bond auction drew slightly weaker demand than its 12-month average as investors turned cautious ahead of this month’s Bank of Japan meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
